description: USA Severe Weather Reports Dashboard is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. The National Weather Service collects reports of severe weather events and weather-related damage and continuously updates this information each day. These reports are preliminary, whereas official verified reports are housed at the NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. This ArcGIS Dashboard displays Local Storm Reports from the 122 forecast offices across the U.S. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Weather, disaster, emergency, tornado, hail, NOAA, earth observations, landscape. The hub shows 2026-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
